bullets: Consolidates disparate data silos into unified OneLake storage using open Delta Parquet files.
Decouples storage compute via Snowflake Polaris Catalog for multi-engine interoperability (Spark, Trino, Snowflake).
Implements partition pruning and min/max metadata indexes to accelerate large-scale analytical scans.
data.interview_framing: Compare the architectural governance trade-offs of Microsoft Fabric OneLake Direct Lake mode against Snowflake Managed Iceberg tables.

flashcards.question: Why are enterprise teams migrating from proprietary data warehouse tables to Apache Iceberg metadata catalogs?
flashcards.answer: Iceberg eliminates vendor lock-in by storing data in open Parquet format on customer cloud storage, allowing multiple compute engines (Snowflake, Spark, Trino) to query identical data with ACID transactions.

full_articles.data:
Title: Open Table Formats: Delta Lake vs Apache Iceberg
Source: Microsoft & Snowflake Architecture (2026)

Section 1: The Multi-Engine Lakehouse Architecture.
Modern data platforms store petabyte-scale data in customer-owned cloud object storage (Azure Blob, AWS S3) formatted as open Parquet files. Apache Iceberg manages snapshot isolation and schema evolution, enabling concurrent access from Snowflake, Apache Spark, and DuckDB without data duplication.
